row:
Slices from the unusual, uncommon and unafraid life of Dr. Don and his best friend, Hank the Dog. Haters and hard-of-heart not welcome! All others, come right on in. Hank the Dog’s tail is already wagging. You might think Dr. Don is a Vet. Right? No. He's a chiropractor. But Hank will tell you every time he's 100% dog!!!
